title: Feature: Modern procedural synth music & tooltip z-index fix
body:
This PR makes two major enhancements:
1. Re-engineers the procedural audio engine (`window.WildPulseMusic` in `index.html`) to deliver a gorgeous, modern, and complex techno-synth soundscape. It routes leads through a stereo `Tone.Chorus` and a low-pass `leadFilter` that dynamically ramps cutoff based on active state (Sine/Triangle oscillators, balanced volume defaults). Basic triads are replaced with complex, jazzy, and warm 7th, 9th, and 11th chord structures.
2. Fixes a CSS overlap issue by setting the tooltip element (`#tooltip`) to `z-index: 300000 !important`, forcing it to render in front of the full-sized holographic preview modals (z-index 200020).
